select s.stock_id, s.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, c.category_name, ( select group_concat(pc.category_name order by find_in_set(pc.category_id, concat(c.ancestors, ',', c.category_id)) separator ' / ') from inv_product_category pc where pc.del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(pc.category_id, concat(c.ancestors, ',', c.category_id)) > 0 ) as category_full_path, p.spec, p.unit, s.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, s.warehouse_id, warehouse_dept.dept_name as warehouse_name, s.current_quantity, s.available_quantity, p.safety_stock_min, s.batch_no, s.expiry_date, s.serial_no, s.location_code, s.location_name, s.last_in_time, s.last_out_time from inv_stock s left join inv_product p on p.product_id = s.product_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join inv_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept shop_dept on shop_dept.dept_id = s.shop_dept_id left join sys_dept warehouse_dept on warehouse_dept.dept_id = s.warehouse_id
coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) <= 0
coalesce(p.safety_stock_min, 0) > 0 and coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) > 0 and coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) <= p.safety_stock_min
coalesce(p.safety_stock_min, 0) <= 0
((coalesce(p.safety_stock_min, 0) > 0 and coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) <= p.safety_stock_min) or coalesce(p.safety_stock_min, 0) <= 0)
order by case when coalesce(p.safety_stock_min, 0) <= 0 then 1 else 0 end, coalesce(s.available_quantity, s.current_quantity, 0) asc, s.create_time desc
